overview:
Representative John Mannion, a Democratic incumbent, seeks re-election in a district that leans Democratic by about four points. He faces Republican Kailee Buller, a challenger who has struggled to raise money. Mannion has brought in roughly $3.1 million and holds about $1.4 million on hand, while Buller has raised about $429,000 with roughly $200,000 available. Outside groups have not spent meaningfully on either side.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket put Mannion's chances at 94 to 95 percent. No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the outlook rests on the district's lean, incumbency, and the fundraising gap. Those fundamentals point to a comfortable but not risk-free Democratic hold, with the expected margin in the mid teens.
